exercises.source: Swap Voyage-code-3 for nomic-embed-code self-hosted. Measure the MRR@10 delta. Report whether the gap closes with re-ranking enabled.
exercises.answer: 固定相同语料/commit/query/gold/分词与预算，比较两个嵌入及是否rerank的2×2消融，报告paired per-query MRR/nDCG差和置信区间/失败类型、费用延迟；不能预定模型替换必更差或rerank必闭合差距。

exercises.source: Inject 20% generated code (LLM-produced boilerplate) into the corpus and re-evaluate. Observe retrieval poisoning. Add a "generated" flag to the payload and down-weight those hits.
exercises.answer: 人工生成代码污染应与真实generated标签区分；保留相关generated实现和关键接口，按重复簇/生成marker和语义证据降低重复占额，并在原创/生成/混合问题分别测证据集合recall，不能一刀删除20%。

exercises.source: Benchmark Qdrant hybrid search vs pgvector + pgvectorscale at your corpus size. Report p99 at batch size 1.
exercises.answer: 固定vector维度、模型revision、稀疏索引、ACL、topK、rerank、量化和冷热缓存，测质量/吞吐/尾延迟/内存/更新；所谓50M向量分界不是普适选型规则。

exercises.answer: 冻结独立gold集与版本，weekly只是示例；区分5%相对下降/5百分点，query mix、权限变化、源更新与模型失效分别核，加入index generation freshness与可复现失败轨迹。

source.question: Why is naive cosine search over raw chunks insufficient for cross-repo code retrieval?
options: Vector indexes cannot store payloads larger than 1KB
Cosine similarity is undefined on code embeddings
Embedding models do not see code as tokens
It poisons results on generated code, monorepo duplication, and rarely imported symbols

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：向量搜索可能漏精确符号并受重复/生成副本影响；并非所有纯向量查询必失败，是否需图/混合应实测。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/12-文本检索与RAG文档工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 02：测验与中文解释

source.question: What does AST-aware chunking mean in the ingestion pipeline?
options: Splitting code into fixed 256-token windows
Compressing chunks with gzip before storage
Cutting at tree-sitter node boundaries such as function and class spans
Dropping comments and whitespace before embedding

quiz.reference_answer: 选3（index2）：AST节点span切分保留函数类结构，超长函数/配置/解析失败另有回退；并非固定token永远不允许。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/12-文本检索与RAG文档工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 02：测验与中文解释

source.question: Which three retrievable modalities does each chunk get in this pipeline?
options: Raw text, gzip, and hash
Token IDs, syntax tree, and call graph
AST, IR, and bytecode
Dense embedding, BM25 terms, and a natural-language summary

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：dense、sparse词项、自然语言摘要是蓝图表征，summary仍需标为派生/可失真且不替原文。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/12-文本检索与RAG文档工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 02：测验与中文解释

source.question: What is the role of the cross-encoder reranker after the hybrid retrieval step?
options: It scores each query-candidate pair together for higher accuracy than cosine alone
It rewrites the chunks to remove generated code
It re-embeds the query in a different model
It compresses the chunks before sending to the synthesizer

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：联合query-candidate重排细交互，不能恢复未召回证据；原TS未实现cross encoder。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/12-文本检索与RAG文档工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 02：测验与中文解释

source.question: Why does the synthesizer reject answers without (repo/path:start-end) anchors?
options: Citation faithfulness gates the answer so users can verify each claim
Anchors are required by the vector database schema
Anchors reduce token cost on the synthesis call
Anchors are needed for downstream BM25 reranking

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：锚点便于回查，但解析到anchor不自动证明faithfulness，必须核逐主张支持、版本与权限。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/12-文本检索与RAG文档工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 02：测验与中文解释

source.question: What does incremental re-index require to stay under 60 seconds on a 50-file push?
options: Dropping the symbol graph entirely
Throwing away the BM25 index and rebuilding it from scratch
Re-embedding the full 2M-LOC corpus on each commit
Re-embedding only chunks whose text changed and recomputing affected symbol edges

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：只重embed变化块并更新受影响edge；还处理删除重命名/事件乱序/generation原子切换，60s需实测。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/12-文本检索与RAG文档工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 02：测验与中文解释

source.question: Which metric measures whether retrieved claims are verifiable in the source?
options: Citation faithfulness
p95 query latency
nDCG@10
MRR@10

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：faithfulness检验主张与source support，MRR/nDCG是排行；链接可打开但不支持主张不能计成功。

exercises.source_prompt: Add an interruption-arbitration policy: what does the agent do when the user barges in during a tool call? Compare three policies (hard cancel, finish-tool-then-stop, queue next turn).
exercises.中文参考判断: 打断during tool分别定义硬取消、完成但不发旧答、排队下一轮，测迟到结果/副作用/用户等待/授权撤销；生成epoch与工具effect ledger是关键，不能把hard cancel当rollback。

quiz.source_question: Why can a voice agent not be built by stitching three blocking REST calls?
quiz.source_correct_option: End-to-end latency below 800ms requires pipelined streaming at every stage
quiz.中文核对与修正: 串联blocking批处理会累加等待；流水流式常能降低首音频，800ms是作业目标而非REST理论下限。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: What is the role of the turn-detector alongside VAD?
quiz.source_correct_option: Reads partial transcripts and scores whether the user has actually finished their utterance
quiz.中文核对与修正: 语义turn detector结合partial/上下文估完成；VAD只给活动线索。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: When the user starts speaking while the agent is mid-response, what must happen for barge-in to feel right?
quiz.source_correct_option: The TTS is canceled immediately, remaining LLM output is dropped, and ASR re-arms
quiz.中文核对与修正: 中断要停生成/播放、清队列、丢旧epoch、更新已听历史；实际工具副作用另核，不能只有cancel日志。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Why is a short filler such as "one second, let me check" emitted when a tool exceeds about 300ms?
quiz.source_correct_option: It avoids silence so the conversation does not stall while the side-channel tool runs
quiz.中文核对与修正: 确认句告知等待，不代表工具已成功，300ms仅政策示例。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: The first audio chunk must leave the server within roughly how long of the first LLM token?
quiz.source_correct_option: 200ms
quiz.中文核对与修正: 200ms是此题的LLM首token至server首音频预算，未覆盖VAD/网络/播放。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Which metric directly measures inappropriate barge-in or over-eager turn closure?
quiz.source_correct_option: False-cutoff rate
quiz.中文核对与修正: 错误提前commit与错误停止agent播放应有两个指标/人工标注；总称false-cutoff可能混分母。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Under 3% packet loss, which two adaptive behaviors does the pipeline rely on?
quiz.source_correct_option: Holding partial transcripts and raising the VAD speech-gate threshold
quiz.中文核对与修正: 源码没有实现包丢失适配；提高阈值不是普适方法，抖动、PLC、ASR/VAD鲁棒性需独立实验。

exercises.source: Measure ColQwen2.5-v0.2 vs ColQwen3-omni on the same corpus. Which pages does one get right and the other miss? Add a "content class" tag to the index to route by type.
exercises.answer: 固定相同PDF/page render/revision/gold与encoder配置，在文本、表、图、手写、公式分层测查询集合recall/nDCG并回查误页；型号/leaderboard先官方核，不能把源码hash-token结果当真实模型比较。

exercises.source: Prune embeddings aggressively (75%, 90%). Find the compression cliff: the point where ViDoRe nDCG@5 drops below the OCR baseline.
exercises.answer: 压缩ratio注明按patch数还是字节，分别测50/75/90%和pooling/量化；同题paired ranking+answer support与边界，找自己任务质量阈值，不把论文小降幅宣称普遍cliff。

exercises.source: Build a hybrid: run OCR-then-text and ColQwen in parallel, fuse with RRF, rerank with a cross-encoder. Does the hybrid beat either alone? Where does it help most?
exercises.answer: 两个pipeline共享docrevision/pageidentity/ACL，独立召回→RRF dedup→适合视觉/文本的rerank；text crossencoder不能直接吞pagepixels，保存候选metadata再VLM/OCR。测混合补哪种漏证据也记额外费用。

source.question: Why does the 2026 frontier prefer vision-first late interaction over OCR-then-text on financial PDFs and scientific papers?
options: OCR pipelines mangle rotated tables, dense equations, and chart imagery, losing half the signal
OCR cannot run on GPUs
Vision models are cheaper per page
OCR is slower than rendering

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）方向：OCR可能破坏布局/表/图信号；去掉固定“损失一半”和视觉必胜断言。

source.question: What does late interaction mean in ColPali-style retrieval?
options: Each query token scores against every patch token, and per-token maxima are summed via MaxSim
Embeddings are computed after the user clicks a result
The reranker only runs on the final candidate
Embeddings are deferred until eval time

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：每query token取document向量最大相似后求和，需mask/dim/encoder一致和空输入拒绝。

source.question: Roughly how many patch vectors does a ColQwen embedding produce per page, and what storage problem does that create?
options: Exactly 128 vectors, fitting cleanly in any vector DB
Around 2048 patch vectors per page, ballooning raw storage compared with single-vector indexes
1 vector per page, no storage issue
16 vectors with negligible storage overhead

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）为教材举例，patch数与分辨率/模型相关并非恒定2048，storage按实际shape dtype计算。

source.question: What does DocPruner do in this pipeline?
options: Removes duplicate PDF pages before ingestion
Compresses the multi-vector index by keeping high-signal patches at about 50% with negligible accuracy loss
Crops bounding boxes around evidence regions
Rewrites the query embedding for shorter vectors

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）为目标剪枝思想；教材程序仅L1 heuristic，无权宣称DocPruner准确率/50%压缩保证。

source.question: Why is an OCR text channel still spliced in for some pages?
options: VLMs cannot read images at 180 DPI
OCR is the primary retrieval modality
It improves PDF rendering quality
Equation-dense and table-heavy pages benefit from a text fallback alongside the image

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：OCR可补公式/表的结构化文本与精确回查，是否改善通过相同gold消融证明。

options: ViDoRe v3
RewardBench-2
MMLU-Pro
SWE-bench Pro

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）是题设检索benchmark名称；须锁数据/benchmarkrevision不把课程scale成绩当实跑。

source.question: What does the rubric mean by evidence-region grounding?
options: Re-ranker latency at the p99 tail
Total number of pages retrieved per query
Fraction of cited bounding boxes that actually contain the answer span
Compression ratio achieved by DocPruner

quiz.reference_answer: 选3（index2）：region是否实际支撑主张，正面积bbox/最高patch/可渲染都不能替代支持率。

source.question: What search shape does the AI-Scientist-class agent use to explore experiments?
options: Breadth-first expansion with random scoring
Beam search over token outputs
Pure reinforcement learning from human feedback
Best-first tree search over experiment nodes with a novelty x quality x budget score

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）为课程设计方向；不是AI-Scientist全家唯一搜索，自己的heap不等AB-MCTS，教材×与实际sum分开。

source.question: Why is the sandbox configured with --network=none and bounded resource caps?
options: To force the agent to use prompt caching
To prevent network egress and contain experiment side effects within a reproducible envelope
To enforce deterministic floating-point arithmetic
To allow GPU passthrough by default

quiz.source_question: What does the contamination check guard against during data preparation?
quiz.source_correct_option: Test-set leakage from public benchmarks such as MMLU-Pro and MT-Bench-v2 into training data
quiz.中文核对与修正: 保护评测独立性，应扫描train/dev及调参影响，不只是validation，并保MinHash局限。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Why does the pipeline compose SFT then DPO (or GRPO) rather than DPO alone?
quiz.source_correct_option: SFT establishes domain behavior on labeled completions while DPO or GRPO aligns the model against preference pairs or verifiable rewards
quiz.中文核对与修正: SFT可先建立行为；DPO偏好、GRPO可核reward是不同目标，串行不是唯一合法路径。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/04-微调与参数高效适配.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: What does EAGLE-3 contribute to the vLLM serving stage?
quiz.source_correct_option: Draft heads that predict N tokens ahead; the target verifies in one pass for 2-3x throughput
quiz.中文核对与修正: EAGLE3候选经target验证可省串行调用，速度取决成本/负载，2–3x不是保证。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/04-微调与参数高效适配.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Which metric reports how well a speculative-decoding draft aligns with the target model?
quiz.source_correct_option: Acceptance rate
quiz.中文核对与修正: acceptance定义须分候选、接受prefix和末轮截断，不直接等准确率/端到端speed。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/04-微调与参数高效适配.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Which trio of quants does the pipeline ship for deployment flexibility?
quiz.source_correct_option: GPTQ-INT4-Marlin, AWQ-INT4, and GGUF-Q4_K_M
quiz.中文核对与修正: GPTQ/AWQ是量化方法/实现组合，GGUF是容器及量化生态，不能仅换后缀获得等效权重。

quiz.source_correct_option: Model Openness Framework (MOF) 2026 template covering data, training, eval, safety, license, and reproducibility
quiz.中文核对与修正: MOF属于LF AI&Data开放性/许可完整框架，与model-card职责相互补充，没有已核2026唯一模板。

source.question: Why does prompt caching matter so much in a regulated-domain RAG chatbot?
options: It eliminates hallucinations
At 60-80% hit rate it cuts per-query cost 3-5x by discounting stable prefix tokens
It removes the need for a vector database
It improves recall on the rerank stage

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）有条件成本方向，去掉60-80%hit必3-5x；output/未cache动态/各stage费可限制节省。

source.question: What goes into the cache header versus the uncached suffix of each request?
options: Random text padding to hit cache size
Only the retrieved documents
User question first, system prompt last
System prompt and static policies in the cache header, reranked context as cache extension, user question as the uncached suffix

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：稳定system/policy前缀、动态context扩展与user尾；写入/最小tokens/TTL/model合同仍必核。

It blocks the response after generation only
It runs a separate index per country
Role and jurisdiction filters apply before the hybrid search merge so chunks outside the user's scope are never reranked

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）是正确目标，原TS只boost违规；role/jurisdiction自己报不授权，所有通道scope核。

A single LLM-judge faithfulness check

quiz.source_question: Which ingest schema do Langfuse, Phoenix, and OpenLLMetry converge on?
quiz.source_correct_option: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions over OTLP HTTP
quiz.中文核对与修正: OTLP+版本语义规范是可组合合同，但产品/SDK需实际adapter与测试；不保证全互通。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Why separate ClickHouse and Postgres in the storage tier?
quiz.source_correct_option: ClickHouse handles columnar analytics over spans while Postgres holds users, sessions, and app metadata
quiz.中文核对与修正: columnstore便于大量span分析，relational适合用户/权限元数据；可不同部署选项，不是唯一架构。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/19-评估和监控.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: What does the tail-sampling processor in the OpenTelemetry Collector do?
quiz.source_correct_option: Decides whether to keep a trace after it completes, using rules like keep errors plus sample successes
quiz.中文核对与修正: Tail sampler等待decision window与可用span，不知道任意未来事件，需说明late/eval/capacity。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/19-评估和监控.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: How does the dashboard detect drift across weeks?
quiz.source_correct_option: Computes PSI or KL divergence on pooled prompt embeddings and watches eval-score trends
quiz.中文核对与修正: PSI/KL仅检指定分布变化，hash不是embedding，无质量真值。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/19-评估和监控.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: What is the deliverable's MTTR target on an injected PII-leak regression?
quiz.source_correct_option: Under 5 minutes from bug deployed to Slack alert
quiz.中文核对与修正: 五分钟是作业检出/通知目标，应叫MTTD/alert latency，恢复完成才算repair/recovery time。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/19-评估和监控.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Which SDK families must produce canonical GenAI spans to meet the trace-coverage rubric?
quiz.source_correct_option: At least six: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google GenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and vLLM
quiz.中文核对与修正: sixSDK为source rubric数量，不替真实schema回归覆盖。

quiz.source_question: How are evaluation results linked back to the original LLM call?
quiz.source_correct_option: As eval spans written as children of the parent trace in ClickHouse
quiz.中文核对与修正: eval可以child但异步任务可独立trace+link；保trace/span和eval版本关联，不要求全部child。

quiz.source_question: Why is a scene-level index still needed even when a long-context VLM can read a 2-hour video natively?
quiz.source_correct_option: Ingesting 100 hours of video into a queryable corpus needs scene-level retrieval, even when individual videos can be read whole
quiz.中文核对与修正: 大语料可用分片索引减少重复费用并精确定位，longcontext也可任务替代，并非唯一必需。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Which three vector types does each scene get in the multi-vector index?
quiz.source_correct_option: Caption embedding, keyframe embedding, and transcript embedding
quiz.中文核对与修正: caption/frame/transcript三named representations；维度/空间可不同，不等Qdrantmultivector矩阵。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: How are results from the three retrieval streams merged at query time?
quiz.source_correct_option: Via reciprocal rank fusion across the three ranked lists
quiz.中文核对与修正: RRF以名次融合可避原cosine不同标度；需同实体ID去重。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: What does the temporal grounding step refine inside the top scene?
quiz.source_correct_option: The (start, end) timestamp window that contains the answer
quiz.中文核对与修正: 单scene细化必须在其原时间区间内，不然换多scene evidence。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Which question class is reported separately because it is a known hallucination hotspot?
quiz.source_correct_option: Counting and action-type questions, where VLMs miscount or mis-order events
quiz.中文核对与修正: 计数/action易被single keyframe或转写误导，分层报真值/unknown/证据，不只overall。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Which grounding metric does the rubric measure on a held-out set?
quiz.source_correct_option: Temporal-grounding intersection-over-union (IoU)
quiz.中文核对与修正: tIoU必须同原视频时间坐标，报告localization和QA准确率分别。

最终中文参考落点.file: LLM 工程实践/08-多模态模型工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 七道原测验的中文核对

quiz.source_question: Why does the pipeline require cited timestamps in answers?
quiz.source_correct_option: They let the viewer jump to the exact (video_id, start, end) so users can verify the claim
quiz.中文核对与修正: 引用便于点击审核，不自动证明答案/时间是正确真值。

source.question: Why does this capstone use both server.json and server/discover?
options: server.json stores sessions, while server/discover deletes them
The Registry requires both files to contain identical version dates
They are two names for the same tool manifest
server.json publishes install and endpoint metadata, while server/discover reports live protocol capabilities
source.explanation: The Registry record helps clients locate and configure a server. The live RPC reports what the running process supports. Their schemas and version domains are independent, but the published identity must use the authenticated namespace and match live serverInfo.

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：发布与runtime发现两层独立；name/schema有效不证明namespaceownership、actualremote健康或工具安全。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 13：测验与中文解释

source.question: What replaces the initialize handshake in MCP revision 2026-07-28?
options: Mcp-Session-Id plus notifications/initialized
Every request carries protocol version and client capabilities, and clients can call mandatory server/discover
A GET request that opens a permanent server stream
A session cookie sent once per TCP connection
source.explanation: The protocol is stateless. Version and capabilities are request metadata, while server/discover provides live version and capability discovery without creating a session.

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）：逐requestmetadata取代handshake，2026版明确，旧server兼容需独立adapter而非混用状态。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/06-MCP通信与状态工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 13：测验与中文解释

source.question: Which tools/list behavior supports safe and efficient discovery?
options: A response cached forever without a scope
A random tool order on each replica
A connection-local list created during initialize
Deterministic order plus ttlMs and a correct public or private cacheScope
source.explanation: Stable ordering improves reproducibility and prompt caching. ttlMs communicates freshness, and cacheScope prevents user-specific results from leaking through shared caches.

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：deterministic order+TTL+scope；privatevisibility勿publicreuse，stale反应要status/pin核。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/06-MCP通信与状态工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 13：测验与中文解释

source.question: Which Streamable HTTP design matches the current stateless transport?
options: All clients require sticky load-balancer routing
POST creates a session, GET resumes it, and DELETE closes it
A standalone GET stream uses Last-Event-ID replay
Each JSON-RPC message uses its own POST, with JSON or request-scoped SSE for a request
source.explanation: Current Streamable HTTP is POST-only for MCP messages and has no protocol session, standalone GET stream, session DELETE, or Last-Event-ID resumability.

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：每JSONRPC新POST回应JSON/requestSSE；accepted notification202 no body，SSE关闭取消，不自动durabletaskcancel。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 13：测验与中文解释

source.question: What must a production server validate before a policy-approved tool handler runs?
options: Only that server.json lists the remote URL
Only the tool's destructiveHint annotation
Only that a human posted an approval message
Protocol metadata plus token issuer, audience or resource, expiry, scope, and any exact-action approval
source.explanation: Transport metadata, token validation, and policy are separate gates. Annotations and publication metadata do not grant authority.

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：metadata、可信token、scope、exactaction不同gate；原TS未集成auth、Pythontokenmock无signature。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/06-专题扩展/06-MCP通信与状态工程.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase19 13：测验与中文解释

source.question: Which evidence best supports the claim that the server scales without protocol sessions?
options: A server.json remote entry
A wire-level concurrent run across two interchangeable replicas with no affinity dependency
A unit test that constructs one response dictionary
A diagram showing a load balancer
source.explanation: The real transport and deployment boundary must be exercised. Alternating requests across replicas proves correctness is not hidden in one process or sticky session.

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）：真实双replicas并发wire且无affinity依赖；dict tests、目录entry、diagram都不是部署证据。

exercises.source: Run the efficacy study with and without the adaptive learner model (random concept order). Report the delta. Expect adaptive to win, but the size is the interesting number.
exercises.answer: 对比固定学习内容/teacher actions/contact time，只改adaptive技能模型相关策略；randomorder改变先修可混杂，模拟不预定adaptive赢；primarygain需实测独立题，reportedCI和dropout。

exercises.source: Add a multimodal probe: the same concept question delivered as text, voice, and photo. Measure whether learners converge faster with the modality they prefer.
exercises.answer: 同concept不同题形式（避免背答案）、顺序平衡或合理random，按ASR/OCR错误与先修/偏好分层测正确率/提示/延迟保持；主观喜欢不等学习gain，语音photo带额外隐私scope。

source.question: What does a Socratic tutor policy do when a learner asks for the answer outright?
options: Switches to a different concept node
Logs the request and goes silent
Asks a leading question that scaffolds the learner toward the answer
Provides the answer immediately and moves on

quiz.reference_answer: 选3（index2）：先提指导问题/分步提示，卡住时可明确讲解不死守neveranswer。

source.question: Which structure does the curriculum graph encode?
options: Only the most recently studied node
A random shuffle of topics
A directed graph of concepts with prerequisite edges, attached to OER content
A flat list of unrelated concepts

quiz.reference_answer: 选3（index2）：先修DAG+资源关联，须validate完整IDs/edges，不等随意Neo4j节点可按图学。

source.question: What does the learner model update after each interaction?
options: The curriculum graph schema
The base LLM's weights
Per-concept mastery probability via Bayesian knowledge tracing or a similar variant
The COPPA retention policy

quiz.reference_answer: 选3（index2）：更新每技能belief；原TS是成功率平滑非BKT，参数valid/modelcalibration另核。

source.question: How is memory split between episodic and semantic stores?
options: Episodic is for the parent; semantic is for the learner
Episodic holds every interaction; semantic holds compacted mistakes and preferences promoted from episodic
Episodic holds embeddings; semantic holds raw audio
They are duplicates of the same data

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）：episode轨迹与semantic错题偏好派生分开；不必永存每交互，保留minimum purpose与删除传播。

source.question: Which constraint shapes memory retention for K-12 learners?
options: COPPA-aware retention with auto-deletion after a defined window and parental access
Retention based on model context length
Permanent retention with no deletion
GDPR only

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：特定适用COPPA与definedpurposewindow/parent rights，教材1year不是法律允许/强制期。

source.question: What is the structure of the efficacy study used to gate the deliverable?
options: A single one-hour session with one learner
Anonymous internet survey
A 30-second AB test
Pre-test and post-test over two weeks with 10 learners, compared against a non-adaptive baseline cohort

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）为pilot设计，10+10两周不足自动证明疗效/全体学习提升；模拟不人study。

source.question: Which multimodal input paths does the tutor expose to the learner?
options: Photo only via a custom OCR model
Text typed, voice via LiveKit + Whisper, and photo math via dots.ocr or PaliGemma 2
Text only
Voice only with no text or photo

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）为multimodal目标，源码并没真正voice/photo/learn；先核识别输入和合法隐私。
